17. Atha vā pana anabhirato anabhiratiṃ āpanno, sikkhaṃ paccakkhātukāmo, sikkhāpadaṃ apaccakkhāya, maṅku-bhūto lajjamāno jigucchamāno gihibhāvaṃ pattheti, yāva vā pana sakyaputtiyo na bhavissāmīti bhāyanto, "mātā me atthi, sā maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "pitā me atthi, so maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "bhātā me atthi, so maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "bhaginī me atthi, sā maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "putto me atthi, so maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "dhītā me atthi, sā maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "bhariyā me atthi, sā maṃ posessatī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "ñātī me atthi, te maṃ posessantī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "mittā me atthi, te maṃ posessantī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "gāmo me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "nigamo me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "khettaṃ me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "vatthu me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "hiraññaṃ me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "suvaṇṇaṃ me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, yāva vā pana "sippaṃ me atthi, tena yāpessāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dubbalyaṃ pakāsitaṃ hoti, sikkhā paccakkhātā hoti.

18. Atha vā pana anabhirato anabhiratiṃ āpanno, sikkhaṃ paccakkhātukāmo, sikkhāpadaṃ apaccakkhāya, maṅku-bhūto lajjamāno jigucchamāno gihibhāvaṃ pattheti, yāva vā pana sakyaputtiyo na bhavissāmīti bhāyanto, "dukkhanti" sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti, "atidukkhanti", "asahanīyanti", "na sukharūpanti", "na me ussahoti", "na saddahāmīti", "na abhiramāmīti", yāva vā pana "na ramāmīti" sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dubbalyaṃ pakāsitaṃ hoti, sikkhā paccakkhātā hoti.

19. Kathañca, bhikkhave, dubbalyaṃ pakāsitaṃ hoti, sikkhā paccakkhātā hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anabhirato anabhiratiṃ āpanno, sikkhaṃ paccakkhātukāmo, sikkhāpadaṃ apaccakkhāya, maṅku-bhūto lajjamāno jigucchamāno gihibhāvaṃ pattheti, yāva vā pana sakyaputtiyo na bhavissāmīti bhāyanto, "buddhaṃ paccakkhāmī"ti sikkhaṃ paccakkhāti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dubbalyaṃ pakāsitaṃ hoti, sikkhā paccakkhātā hoti.
